text:
jordan: quick heads-up — we're doing the nightly backfill + dual-write cutover tonight. window 00:30–02:30 PST. primary deploy owner: @sam. canary first at 00:45. please confirm smoke/rollback owners.
meera: ack. I'll own smoke checks for user-profile writes. will run the usual smoke script and validate counts.
sam: sounds good. I'm on deploy. plan is: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. manual pause between steps. rollback toggles ready.
rachael: I'll take rollback if anything quota/backfill lag spikes. @sam — do you need DB role handoff?
sam: @rachael yes pls. I'll handoff role at 00:20. will push a note to oncall.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: nightly-backfill-2026-04-19 at 00:30 PST by sam. Canary job queued for 00:45.
meera: quick checklist:
- run `scripts/smoke/user_write_smoke.sh` after canary
- verify `select count(*) from user_profiles where updated_at > now() - interval '1 hour'` roughly matches canary traffic
- check replication lag < 500ms
sam: putting commands in runbook:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/user-service
./tools/backfill_runner --config backfills/2026-04-user.json --dry-run
```
meera: will run the smoke within 10m of canary start and post results here.
rachael: rollback plan summary:
- flip feature flag `user_profiles_dualwrite` to `off`
- cancel backfill jobs via `./tools/backfill_runner --cancel <job-id>`
- revert schema migration (if needed) using db-migrations rollback <tag> (requires approval)
sam: noted. please make sure the FF toggle has perms for ops group.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: rachael is primary from 00:00–08:00 PST. Paging rules in place.
meera: minor risk: large accounts might generate heavy KV cache misses during dualwrite. I'll monitor tail latency graphs (p99) and token ops.
jordan: if smoke shows >5% error rate or p95 latency >500ms, hold and escalate.
sam: if we need to abort mid-rollout I'll post `ABORT` in this thread and run rollback steps.
rachael: I'll pre-stage rollback commands and keep a terminal open. will post readiness: ✅ when done.
meera: smoke start: 00:46 PST, results: basic write smoke OK, counts within 1.3% of expected. replication lag at 120ms. p95 latency 210ms.
sam: canary -> 10% at 01:00 PST. pinging infra to watch GPU queue (backfill runner uses batch nodes).
deploy-bot: Canary moved to 10% at 01:00 PST.
rachael: monitoring — no errors, small spikes but within tolerance. ready to proceed.
jordan: proceed to 50% at 01:15. keep an eye on backfill throughput.
meera: 50% smoke check running. will report in 5m.
sam: if anything odd, use `ABORT` and notify oncall.
meera: 50% results: counts +2.8% (still okay), p95 290ms, replication lag 300ms. no errors.
rachael: I think we can complete to 100% at 01:40. I'll be on standby for rollback.
sam: moving to 100% now. starting final backfill merge jobs.
oncall-bot: Reminder: log retention for this deploy will be 72h for quick postmortem.
jordan: great work — once fully complete, please post final confirmation and any follow-ups for next-day cleanup (cron job to disable temp logging, etc.).
meera: final: backfill completed, dualwrite flag steady. no anomalies in the window. closing handoff.
sam: done — deploy succeeded. thanks everyone. :trophy:
rachael: acknowledged. will file a short runbook update with the slight tweaks we had to the smoke thresholds.
jordan: thanks team — marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
